item.title: Study shows how children learn to talk about characters' thoughts and feelings in stories
item.description: An international research effort has examined how children develop the ability to express what story characters think, feel and perceive. Research groups from around the world collected 5,507 picture-based stories from 2,763 typically developing monolingual and bilingual children ages 3 to 13. item.title: Rule gives every generation same share of its best attainable welfare
item.description: Sharing a finite resource across generations requires a balance between today's needs and the claims of those yet to be born. Research by Prof. Thomas A. Weber, presented at the 2026 European Control Conference in Reykjavík, proposes a fair allocation rule that gives every generation the same fraction of its best attainable welfare. The approach preserves access for all future generations and provides a performance guarantee without requiring agreement on a single social objective. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Quantum technologies are considered key technologies of the future. The first Bose–Einstein condensates were observed in ultracold atomic gases at temperatures close to absolute zero. item.title: Gravity and light reveal how liquids turn into thin fibers
item.description: From spiders spinning their webs to the manufacturing of textiles, the formation of fibers from liquids plays an important role in both nature and industry.
